game.title: Ryse: Son of Rome
game.blurb: Third-person melee action game set in Rome and Britannia, from Crytek, released 2013-11-22. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: Marius Titus's story across eight levels, from The Beginning and S.P.Q.R. to The Son Of Rome. Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Legendary and Harder Difficulties
chapters.summary: Every level on Legendary, and finishing the game on Soldier and Centurion difficulty.

chapters.title: Vistas, Scrolls and Chronicles
chapters.summary: Finding every Vista, Scroll and Chronicle, and completing a comic book in a level.

chapters.title: Colosseum Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Co-op Colosseum campaigns, ranks, Rewards of the Gods, item tiers and the arena maps.

chapters.title: Survival Mode
chapters.summary: Surviving seven minutes in Courtyard, Firestorm and Dockyard, and a round on Island.

chapters.title: Executions, Combos and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Execution counts, environmental executions, damage-free combo streaks and buying upgrades.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Ryse: Son of Rome" or "Ryse". ryse.fandom.com does not exist (HTTP 404); rysesonofrome.fandom.com answers the API with a "Ryse: Son of Rome" page of about 27 linked pages, including "Marius Titus", "Nero", "Boudica", "Britannia" and "XIV Legion"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 11 of 73 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the campaign chapter as a placeholder, though some (for example "Medium Rare", "There's No Such Thing As Luck" and "Step Right This Way!") may be combat feats. "Complete Invictus", "Complete Barbarous", "Complete False Gods" and "Complete Beacon" do not say what they are; they sit among the multiplayer achievements in the schema and have low unlock rates (5 to 6%), so they were put in the Colosseum chapter, which is a judgement call. The summary's hero name comes from the Fandom page "Marius Titus" and the achievement "Saving Private Marius". RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours.
